req.title: Create requires title
req.statement: The system shall render 'Title is required.' when POST /create omits the title field.

doc.reasoning: The violation was test[4] having kind='negative' but heuristic='STC'. The rule requires that a negative kind test must not use STC heuristic. Fix: change test[4] (test_create_unauthenticated_redirects_to_login) from heuristic='STC' to heuristic='NEG', which is the correct heuristic for a negative test covering an invalid/unauthenticated state. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_create_with_valid_title_succeeds
preconditions: App initialised with TESTING=True and fresh temp DB
DB seeded with fixture user id=1 (test/test)
actions: POST /create with title='Hello World', body='Some body'
expected: Response body does NOT contain 'Title is required.'
trace: R-FLASKR-016: valid title must not trigger the error path
blog.create() inserts post and redirects when title is non-empty
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

# Log in as fixture user
r_login = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
assert r_login.status_code == 302

# POST /create with a valid title
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Hello World', 'body': 'Some body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
assert b'Title is required.' not in r.data

os.unlink(path)

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

r_login = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
assert r_login.status_code == 302

r = client.post('/create', data={'title': '', 'body': 'body'})
assert r.status_code == 200
# Exact casing and punctuation required by R-FLASKR-016
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data
# Must NOT match wrong-case variant
assert b'title is required.' not in r.data
# Must NOT match variant missing the trailing period
assert b'Title is required' in r.data  # substring of correct string — sanity
# Confirm the period is present by checking the full exact string
assert r.data.count(b'Title is required.') >= 1

os.unlink(path)
